name: Story of Man
source:
This story is about a man named Alex and his niece Mila, who live together. Mila's mother fled abroad, leaving her daughter to be raised by Alex.

[From [url=https://itch.io/t/1774398/story-of-man]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个故事讲述了一个名叫亚历克斯的男人和他的侄女米拉住在一起的故事。米拉的母亲逃到国外，留下女儿由亚历克斯抚养。

[来自[url=https://itch.io/t/1774398/story-of-man]Itch.io[/url]]
